proves.claim: buildLocalBoardState on a board of 200,000 events never asks SQLite for more than 5,000 event rows in one read, whole or after a kept history, and returns the same state, history, item meta and clock window as a build from the whole-log read.

store.io-board-hot-state.state-build-rea.why: Without this test, a state build that reads the whole event table in one query, which ran the view's API worker out of heap on a 770k-event board, would pass unnoticed.
